sentences.text: Melilla -LRB- -LSB- məˈliːjə -RSB- ; -LSB- meˈliʎa -RSB- , -LSB- meˈliʝa -RSB- ; Mřič -LSB- , Maliliyyah -RRB- is a Spanish autonomous city located on the north coast of Africa , sharing a border with Morocco with an area of 12.3 km2 .	Spanish	Spain	Africa	Africa	Morocco	Morocco
Melilla , along with Ceuta , is one of two permanently inhabited Spanish cities in mainland Africa .	Spanish	Spain	Africa	Africa	Ceuta	Ceuta
It was part of Málaga province until 14 March 1995 when the city 's Statute of Autonomy was passed .	Málaga province	Province of Málaga	Statute of Autonomy	Statute of Autonomy

, it had a population of 78,476 made up of ethnic Spaniards , ethnic Riffian Berbers , and a small number of Sephardic Jews and Sindhi Hindus .	Riffian Berbers	Riffian people	Sephardic Jews	Sephardic Jews	Sindhi	Sindhi people
